# SpinChainMultipleEntanglementSpectra

Module: **Spin** · directory: `Spin/src/Programs` · binary: `Spin/src/Programs/SpinChainMultipleEntanglementSpectra`

Manual: [SpinChainMultipleEntanglementSpectra (from the DiagHam wiki)](../manuals/SpinChainMultipleEntanglementSpectra.md)

```text
SpinChainMultipleEntanglementSpectra, version 0.01

Usage: SpinChainMultipleEntanglementSpectra [options] 

Options:

system options:
    -s, --spin : twice the spin value (default value = 1)
    --multiple-states : provide as a matrix a series of states whose entanglement spectrum/entropy have to be computed
    --min-multiplestates : index of the first state to consider in the matrix provided by the --multiple-groundstate option (default value = 0)
    --max-multiplestates : index of the last state to consider in the matrix provided by the --multiple-groundstate option (negative if this is the last available state) (default value = -1)
    -c, --complex : consider complex wave function
    --generic-cut : provide a list of sites that define the subsystem instead of the default cut
    --la : subsystem size (negative if half of the system has to be considered) (default value = -1)
    --show-time : show time required for each operation

output options:
    --show-entropies : show the entangelement entropy and trace of the reduced density matrix for each state
    --export-entropies : export in a text file the entangelement entropy and trace of the reduced density matrix for each state
    --counting : count the number of non zero eigenvalues for each entanglement spectrum
    --counting-error : error below which an eigenvalue is consideredto be eual to zero (default value = 9.9999999999999997e-29)

parallelization options:
    -S, --SMP : enable SMP mode
    --processors : number of processors to use in SMP mode (default value = 2)
    --smp-profil : enable SMP profiling, the name of the log file  has to be passed as argument

misc options:
    -h, --help : display this help

global options:
    --append-cmdline : append command line to file
```
